reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multilingual Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the build UI in Provincia! Now, it supports ten languages, ensuring a more inclusive experience for players around the world. Additionally, placement feedback has been enhanced to clearly indicate why certain placements fail, making it easier to build your colony without frustration. Plus, we've optimized day/night transitions to keep gameplay smooth. Learn more about these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: Enhanced UI and Gameplay Mechanics
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce our latest update for Provincia! The build UI now supports ten languages, making the game more accessible.
